fields.title: Cold interface boundary
fields.finding: About 277 K air is the cold edge of the inherited minimum-W screen in the scanned core range. A 0.05 K interval separates optimistic exclusion from first fully feasible tabulation. Source strength transfer and restraint dominate this numerical precision.
fields.missing_evidence: Cold assembled-interface tests and validated spatial restraint.
